scenes.role: reference encounter; first sight of the new neighbour
prerequisites: Nia has a kite and wants company
actions: Nia notices June at her gate
consequences: Introduces the wish to include June
prose_obligations: Make June a person, not a puzzle to solve

prerequisites: Nia has decided to fly that afternoon
actions: Nia chooses to ask June rather than fly alone
consequences: Frames the central want
prose_obligations: Show an ordinary, specific desire

prerequisites: The reel is at the workshop
actions: Nia asks Tomas for the reel
consequences: Makes the borrowing explicit
prose_obligations: Tomas has a distinct, practical voice

prerequisites: Tomas owns the reel
actions: Tomas lends the reel for the afternoon
consequences: The string is available for repair and flight; it must be returned
prose_obligations: Establish care and actual usefulness, not just custody

prerequisites: The reel has been borrowed
actions: Nia carries the reel out
consequences: The party reaches June without an extra episode
prose_obligations: Do not imply travel if the scene is omitted
scenes.consolidation: Borrowing and leaving are atomic actions inside one executable scene.

prerequisites: Nia has left the workshop
actions: Nia approaches June's gate
consequences: June gets to answer for herself
prose_obligations: Avoid making shyness a defect

prerequisites: Nia has asked June to join
actions: Nia offers a small, low-pressure outing
consequences: June accepts and joins the afternoon
prose_obligations: Dialogue changes how the invitation feels

prerequisites: June has accepted
actions: They return to the workbench together
consequences: June participates in preparation
prose_obligations: Preserve who is physically with whom
scenes.consolidation: Entering the workshop, checking the frame, and carrying the kite back out share one playable preparation encounter.

prerequisites: The kite is on the bench
actions: The children check the bamboo frame
consequences: A sound frame can be flown; a split one needs a repair
prose_obligations: Let the physical condition matter

prerequisites: A spar is split and the reel has enough spare line
actions: Nia uses three metres of borrowed string to lash the spar
consequences: The frame is repaired; usable flight line is shorter
prose_obligations: Keep string conservation consistent

prerequisites: The frame has been inspected
actions: June and Nia fit a tail
consequences: Tail weight changes the kite's chance of holding air
prose_obligations: Make the preparation feel collaborative

prerequisites: June has accepted; the kite is not yet prepared
actions: June adds a blue star and shares a small choice
consequences: The mark persists; trust can change who handles the reel
prose_obligations: Only mention the star when this encounter is enacted

prerequisites: The kite is prepared; they have not gone to the common
actions: June tests the wind with a ribbon
consequences: A recorded observation can make June comfortable handling the reel
prose_obligations: Do not grant this knowledge when the vignette is omitted

prerequisites: The kite is prepared
actions: They carry kite and reel to an open field
consequences: All three arrive together
prose_obligations: Track the kite and borrowed reel

prerequisites: The kite is rigged and June has joined
actions: Nia pays out line while June holds the tail
consequences: Wind, frame, tail, and available line determine the first lift
prose_obligations: The reel must visibly do useful work

prerequisites: The kite has lifted and a strong gust catches the line
actions: The children let out slack instead of yanking
consequences: A controlled response can free the line without breaking it
prose_obligations: Do not invent a snag in calm conditions
scenes.consolidation: The snag is staged in the first-lift scene and resolved in the response scene; it is conditional, not a separate executable scene.

prerequisites: The first line check is complete
actions: They free a snag or verify a clear line
consequences: The children can make a safer second decision
prose_obligations: Dialogue should show listening rather than command

prerequisites: June has participated; the line is checked
actions: Nia offers June the reel or the kite tail
consequences: Shyness, trust, and wind observation shape the choice and safe flight
prose_obligations: Both roles must give June real agency

prerequisites: The children have made a safe decision
actions: They fly together when conditions allow, otherwise finish the outing with the grounded kite
consequences: Two complete outcomes; neither ending is an unfulfilled promise
prose_obligations: A grounded kite can still be a shared success
scenes.consolidation: The selected ending performs the resolution and return actions locally.

prerequisites: The outing has reached either ending
actions: They rewind the loose line and return Tomas's reel
consequences: Line is conserved, the loan ends, and its usefulness is acknowledged
prose_obligations: Do not end with custody alone
scenes.consolidation: Landing or folding, walking back, returning the reel, and signing or displaying the kite are actions inside one ending episode.
